name: PT Idea Indonesia Akademi Tbk
summary: PT Idea Indonesia Akademi Tbk primarily specializes in the sourcing, professional development, and placement of personnel for the hospitality sector. This is accomplished through its collaborations with both domestic and international hotel chains and cruise operators. Beyond these core activities, the company also engages in the creation and management of hotels, restaurants, and educational institutions. Established in 2009, its main corporate offices are located in South Jakarta, Indonesia. PT Idea Indonesia Akademi Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Idea Asia Investama.
